name: Jakob
source:
A night watchman. [spoiler]He had a girlfriend called Ingrid who suffered a fatal accident in the past. Since then, he decided to write a book about every injustice he sees as a watchman, no matter who caused it, noble or commoner.
He has an smart alchemist sister ([url=/c4940]Alfrieda[/url]) who, according to him, is the hope of the family in rising from their struggles. It was she who teached him how to write, read, experiment and observe people.[/spoiler]
